Subject: License SKU harmonization + evidence package for logs/metrics/err-reporting

Team —

We're coming up on the Q3 renewal windows for Datadog, Grafana Cloud, and Sentry. Procurement asked that we present: (1) a single SKU map across products (what we actually use vs what we're being billed), (2) suggested retention/ingest changes that meet SLOs, and (3) an evidence package for legal (usage exports + contract excerpts).

Attached is a starting file with current billing SKUs I pulled from the billing console. Can each of you:
- Grace: produce a short SKU -> usage snapshot for logs/metrics (CSV) and call out spike patterns (last 12 months).
- Vivek: capture any architectural blockers if we propose reducing ingested log volume (e.g., services that require full retention).
- Laura: once we have the SKU map, I need a short note on any contract clauses that may block consolidation (eg. minimum seat/ingest commitments or marketplace terms).

Target: consolidate and have an internal ask deck by EOD Wed (19-May) so I can email vendor reps and request formal proposals.

Attachments: sku-usage-202705.xlsx (billing exports stub)

Thanks —
Karthik
Sr. PM, Procurement & Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: License SKU harmonization + evidence package for logs/metrics/err-reporting

Karthik —

Quick turn: attached is a lightweight snapshot (sku-snapshot-202705.csv). Top-line observations:
- Datadog logs ingestion: 8.4 TB/mo (90th day spikes after releases); currently on Ingested Logs + Indexed Logs (premium addons).
- Grafana Cloud metrics: ~1.2B data points/month; retention currently 365 days on the managed tier.
- Sentry: error events ~120K/mo, most volume is from a handful of mobile services (auth/mobile-api).

Recommendations:
- Datadog: move majority of low-value logs to a 30-day hot + cold-archive (4TB moved), keep 90-day indexed retention for 1.5TB of high-value streams.
- Grafana: evaluate a 90->180 day retention tier with compressed cold storage for old series.
- Sentry: implement server-side sampling on mobile-auth to cut event count ~60% without losing signal for alerts.

I'll add brief notes about risks in the sheet (where sampling could impact investigations). No legal blockers identified on our side yet.

Attachments: sku-snapshot-202705.csv

—Grace
Observability PM
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: License SKU harmonization + evidence package for logs/metrics/err-reporting

Hi — forwarding a brief internal snapshot and ask. We are evaluating SKU consolidation across our three vendors and would appreciate: a formal proposal for (a) a consolidated list of SKUs that would cover our current usage with explicit per-SKU pricing, (b) options for hot/cold retention for logs and metrics (including egress and archive fees), and (c) any discounts/credits for consolidating multiple SKUs or committing to a 12/24 month contract.

Attached: sku-snapshot-202705.csv (internal usage), sku-usage-202705.xlsx (billing exports).

Please return a proposal or indicative pricing by COB Thu (20-May). If you need a quick sync, propose times and we'll accommodate.

Thanks,
Karthik

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the snapshot. Quick note on our side: we can produce a consolidated SKU proposal for Grafana Cloud that includes logs, metrics, and traces. Preliminary indicative numbers (very high level):
- Managed metrics tier (1.2B series): $26k/mo base + $0.018 per million series after the included threshold.
- Logs hot retention (30 days) + cold archive (365 days): base $8k/mo + $0.40 per GB/month for archive storage.
- Multi-product consolidation credit: 12% applied if you commit for 12 months across logs+metrics (one-off onboarding waived).

Attachments: GC-Proposal-Redwood-2027.pdf (proposal stub)

We also note integration options to reduce volume (promtail rule suggestions for line-sampling) which align with Grace's notes. If helpful we can book a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk the deck and show expected monthly delta vs current billing.

Best,
Maya Singh
